purpose: Reconcile a complete provided historical measurement-row metadata roster against the observed TRAIN source/action mapping, without reading quality values or claiming a pre-outcome candidate universe.
export_requirements: All rows from each of the 24 six-TRAIN historical measurement files, including non-PASS and unreferenced rows; no eligibility, status, quality, runtime or outcome-conflict values in export.

Source row is the original one-based TSV logical-record ordinal used by the historical CSV reader, header record 1; it is not a byte-line number for multiline quoted fields. Rows must cover 2 through data_row_count+1 exactly, with no source records silently dropped or renumbered.

candidate_id_origin must distinguish explicit original candidate values from one-based data-row fallback IDs. The historical implementation uses fallback for any blank candidate in all four aliases, although its contract highlights refine tables; do not infer origin from alias alone.
Inventory must enumerate all six circuits times four aliases, including explicit zero-row files; declared counts and SHA do not independently authenticate source completeness.
Preserve the original file SHA and each source identifier. Do not derive a supposedly complete roster from edges, PASS-only actions, or eligibility-filtered measurements.
Mapping projection is the distinct source/action/circuit tuple from the already authorized mapping metadata, not a per-session edge table and not a new mapper execution.
implementation_boundary: Pure-memory schema/row coverage validator and synthetic tests. No file reader, exporter, A/B calls, original logs or quality joins.
pre_outcome_evidence_separate_from_roste: Refine parent and generation decisions with input provenance
Authenticated freeze acknowledgement predating outcome access; do not use mtime as proof
Actual invocation/session identity and shared-prefix charging policy, not inferred from a source UID
next_input: Provide the metadata-only roster and 24-file inventory through an explicitly authorized source-side export, or an existing accessible metadata-only artifact with provenance. No need to unseal entire quality directories.
non_certifications: Historical file-row completeness is not proof of all generated or attempted candidates.
PASS-only action construction is outcome-conditioned; dropping quality columns later does not erase this selection.
Pre-outcome freeze requires independent generator/grid/selection evidence and timing provenance; hashes made now do not establish past freeze time.
Shared-session historical cost proxies are not incremental online ATPG wall time.
